title: Information Retrieval from the Ground Up - Philipp Krenn, Elastic
talk_summary: Philipp Krenn demonstrates lexical, vector, sparse, and hybrid retrieval in Elasticsearch, including tokenization, BM25, chunking, RRF, and reranking. The practical core is that retrieval quality depends on ingestion choices and combining cheap exact search with semantic/rerank stages.

takeaways.what_they_do: Combine keyword/BM25 and vector retrieval, then fuse results by reciprocal rank rather than trying to normalize raw scores.
takeaways.evidence_quote: doesn't rely on the score, but it relies on the position of each search mechanism

takeaways.what_they_do: Use a cheap retriever to get top candidates, then run a more expensive higher-quality reranker only on that shortlist.
takeaways.evidence_quote: retrieve the top I don't know a thousand candidates and then we have a more expensive way but higher quality way of actually rescoring them

takeaways.technique: Chunk long context and retrieve matched fragment
takeaways.what_they_do: Split long documents/logs into smaller chunks, retrieve the best matching chunk, and link back to the source fragment.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you want to kind of like reduce the context per element that you're matching because there's only so much context that a dense vector representation can hold

takeaways.what_they_do: Use a content hash as the document ID and create-only writes so unchanged files are rejected instead of re-embedded.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you create the hash of the file and use that as the ID and you only use the operation create

takeaways.what_they_do: Use keyword/BM25 search for exact symbols, paths, error strings, and IDs; reserve vector search for fuzzy conceptual queries.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it will be very hard to beat keyword search

takeaways.what_they_do: Maintain a golden dataset of queries/PRs with known good results, then compare retrieval or reviewer changes against it.
takeaways.evidence_quote: run different queries against it and then you see like is it getting better or is it getting worse
